# Test fixtures

Synthetic FAP pages generated by `tools/fixtures/anonymize.mjs` from pages saved under the git-ignored `ignore/fixtures-raw/`. Structure (elements, classes, attributes, columns) is FAP's; every value is generated: dates are shifted by a whole number of weeks, codes, rooms, logins, ids and numbers of three or more digits are replaced character by character, marks are synthetic, and free text is same-length filler. Regenerate with `node tools/fixtures/anonymize.mjs`; the deny-list check (`npm run check:fixtures`, `.githooks/pre-commit`) must pass before committing.
